missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Рынок' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'открывается'. 'Рано утром' adds the time, giving a simple daily-routine sentence.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Рынок' is inanimate masculine, so its accusative equals the nominative as the object of 'люблю'. 'Местный' is the agreeing masculine adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'От рынка' uses the genitive 'рынка' after 'от' to express proximity. 'Недалеко' specifies the short distance.

missions.phrase: Мы идём на рынок за овощами.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative of destination. 'На рынок' uses the accusative 'рынок' after 'на' to express the goal of motion. 'За овощами' is instrumental, the purpose of going.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'На рынке' uses the prepositional 'рынке' after 'на' to express where the buying happened. 'Фрукты' is the accusative plural object.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'К рынку' uses the dative 'рынку' after 'к' to show movement toward the market. 'Пешком' adds the manner of travel.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after adjective. 'Рынком' is the instrumental required by 'доволен'. 'Новым' is the agreeing masculine instrumental adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'С рынка' uses the genitive 'рынка' after 'с' to express coming from the market. 'Вечером' adds the time of return.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Рынки' is the nominative plural subject of 'работают'. 'Разные' is the agreeing plural adjective, and 'в городе' is a prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Рынки' is the inanimate accusative plural, equal to the nominative plural, as the object of 'любят'. 'Старые восточные' agree in the plural.
